title: COMP Drag Page
summary: Official Derivative common Drag/Drop page for Panel COMP drag enablement, legacy scripts, callback workflow, drop types, alternate dropped operator, drop destination processing, and table-based drop routing.
guidance: Use this article when a Panel COMP should initiate drag, accept drops, inherit parent drag/drop settings, or route drops through scripts.
Prefer the callback workflow for exact behavior; legacy drag/drop uses Drag Script, Drop Destination Script, Dropped Operator, and Drop Script fields.
Drop Types can advertise return values such as OP family names, channels, or supported file types.
The Drop Destination Script runs against a temporary network containing the dragged component or its alternate dropped operator.
The alternative operator must exist; otherwise the component itself is dropped, and text/file drops still use the original.
